status: Validated performance increment; strict FDK gate remains unmet.
measured_candidate: Worktree production sources retained in this commit; exact file hashes in source-manifest.json. Documents/artifacts are outside timed code.
cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

timing.affinity: CPU0 for every timed process; encoder work uses one core.
timing.method: Complete one-shot open/encode/flush/free inside each process; 4 warmups plus31 measured, all6 engine orders for each of4 cells. File reads, generation, verification hashing and strict FFmpeg decode are outside the timer.
timing.clock: Instant / CLOCK_MONOTONIC wall time; no process startup subtraction and no outlier removal.
timing.summary: Median of all186 repetitions per engine/cell; even-size median is mean of middle2 samples. Raw individual observations and block medians retained.
timing.load: Busy shared host; every block records load and CPU0 frequency. Large scheduling modes exist. Reported gains are observations, not universal speed guarantees.

guard_protocol: Base/candidate/candidate/base; 5warmups+31measured,15registered syom_speed cells. Both paired tables retain all samples, matching bytes/FNV; median gains27.0% and27.4%. Bootstrap per-repetition intervals do not eliminate shared-host systematic noise.
accepted_changes: Four independent autocorrelation lag accumulators preserving each scalar add order.
Per-frame short psychoacoustic/group analysis cache; per-frame long peak/noise/scalefactor invariants.
Long-band quantization and Huffman cost reuse keyed on normalized sf, cleared per frame and invalidated for refinement mutations.
Prefix sums preserve greedy section-cost choices, invalid books, saturating sums and tie order.
Rate search retains its selected build; one fitting quality build.
Byte-at-a-time BitWriter; fitted frame emitted directly once; padding appended at original pre-END bit position.

resources.cold_stack_limitation: Isolated release latency test overflows on first cold decoder Huffman-table initialization on BOTH original e8ceb7e and candidate. Not introduced or fixed here. Full default debug test suite passes (512KiB test stack); do not claim blanket cold128KiB decoder support.

Retain that result; run both short cells with all six orders and301 repetitions to reduce short-block scheduling sensitivity, without changing codec sources or removing outliers.
